sentences.text: behold the lamb beat Bo Girds by 5.34, an upset of a team that sat 2nd before the week.
Recent add Germie Bernard decided it with a lucky 20.2, and without Bernard, that is a loss.
Bo Girds's starters dropped 7 passes worth about 17.8, and the drops cost the game.
Bo Girds also started recent add Indianapolis Colts, a free agent pickup that returned -0.85.
Bo Girds has now lost 2 straight.
behold the lamb is 6-6 and sits exactly at the cut, which counts as a rally.
Germie Bernard is the Game Changer, a lucky recent add who scored 20.2 for behold the lamb, 12.07 over projection.
It was an upset: behold the lamb was 11th before the week and beat Bo Girds, who was 2nd.
Without Bernard, that is a loss, against a margin of 5.34.
Bo Girds pitched in on its own loss, with starters dropping 7 passes worth about 17.8, and the drops cost the game.
Bo Girds also started recent add Indianapolis Colts, who scored -0.85, a generous gift to the other side.
To Infinity and Bijan got 6.3 from Bijan Robinson, the Underperformer, which falls some distance short of infinity.
Recent add Germie Bernard scored 20.2 in a 5.34-point win for behold the lamb, which makes the Game Changer a lucky waiver pickup.
Bo Girds collected Butterfingers through Matthew Golden, whose 3 drops were worth about 14.2 points.
London Cooking left MVB Jayden Daniels on the bench for 21 and still won by 66.4.
Lil Fridge beat Brock ‘N’ Roll by 38.48, and the Brock in Brock ‘N’ Roll was Top Scorer with 17.36, which says less about the Brock than about the Roll.
Lil Fridge's recent add Denver Broncos posted a lucky 13.35, while Brock ‘N’ Roll's own recent add defense, the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, answered with 9.65.
Brock ‘N’ Roll sits at 6-6, right on the cut, with 9.1 from recent add Dallas Goedert and Davante Adams and Mike Evans now listed Out, while Lil Fridge now has Romeo Doubs listed IR.
It was an upset in name only: Return of T Mac won by 38.82, and Unsolicited Dak Picks set a season low at 81.47.
Lucky recent add Carnell Tate scored 16 for Return of T Mac, while Unsolicited Dak Picks answered with recent add Kimani Vidal at 5.5.
Unsolicited Dak Picks has now lost 3 straight, with Juwan Johnson contributing exactly 0 and A.J. Brown, now listed Questionable, adding 3.2.
Maye d'force B with U won by 9.51, and without Isaiah Likely, that is a loss; Jaylen Waddle is now listed Questionable (Shoulder).
Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team did get 22.7 from recent add Bhayshul Tuten, then 6.4 from fellow trade arrival Garrett Wilson, which is how a trade averages out.
The loss drops Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team to 4-8, and recent add Dalton Kincaid scored 7.3 and is now listed Questionable (Ribs), so the week 6 trade is going great.
behold the lamb, 11th before the week, pulled the upset on Bo Girds by 5.34, so behold, apparently.
Recent add Germie Bernard was the lucky decider at 20.2, and without him, that is a loss.
Bo Girds's starters dropped 7 passes worth about 17.8, and those drops cost the game.
To Infinity and Bijan posted a season low of 46.08 in a loss to London Cooking, and Bijan scored 6.3, which is one way to honor a team name.
The trade haul delivered in name only: recent add Patrick Mahomes was the Top Scorer for To Infinity and Bijan at 11.48, and recent add Rhamondre Stevenson managed 3.6.
Recent adds Ladd McConkey, at 2.2, and Terry McLaurin, at 3.2, are now listed Out, with a concussion and a knee respectively, so the trades are going great.
All You Need Is Love beat Pukancun on 3 by 12.95, and Tre Tucker decided it by finishing 16.62 over projection.
Pukancun on 3 rebuilt its backfield with recent adds, and the payoff was trade pickup Cam Skattebo at 0 and free agent MarShawn Lloyd at 1.
Pukancun on 3 now sits 5 games below the cut, and the namesake, Puka Nacua, chipped in 11.
Pukancun on 3 was 1-9 and in need of a move, and it chose to send Omarion Hampton and Tony Pollard to Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team for Jacory Croskey-Merritt and David Montgomery.
It gave up Hampton at position rank 23 and took back Montgomery, whose target share fell to 0 percent.
Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team got the higher position rank in Hampton plus Pollard, the back with 17 red-zone carries before the trade, which is a tidy haul for a team sitting 8th.
Pukancun on 3 now holds 5 RB and 0 open roster spots, a deep backfield for the team in 12th.
This week the trade decided Pukancun on 3's matchup: the backs it got scored 0 on the bench while the backs it gave away scored 13.5.
To Infinity and Bijan gave up Dalton Kincaid's 8.3 points per game for Kenyon Sadiq's 6.4, and Sadiq's snap share was heading down at the time.
The case for To Infinity and Bijan is Sadiq's flat 16 percent target share against Kincaid's sinking 8 percent, which is enough for a team in 10th to scrape a C.
Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team gets a B for landing Dalton Kincaid at position rank 12 by season points, though Kincaid had missed projection in 3 of the last 3 weeks.
Giving up Sadiq costs little for a 4-6 team in 8th, since his snap share was already sliding.
This week Kincaid scored 7.3 for Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team while Sadiq sat on the To Infinity and Bijan bench with 1.7, so the infinity part is off to a slow start.
Pukancun on 3 was 1-9 before the trade and finally acted like it, landing Nico Collins and his 26 percent target share.
Cam Skattebo for Rhamondre Stevenson is a small step down at running back, with Skattebo missing projection in 3 of the last 3 weeks.
To Infinity and Bijan, at 4-6, handed over Nico Collins for Ladd McConkey, whose target share was down to 11 percent.
The consolation is Stevenson, who beat projection in 2 of the last 3 weeks, so To Infinity and Bijan at least has a running back to talk about.
In week one of the deal, Skattebo scored 0 for Pukancun on 3 and McConkey scored 2.2 for To Infinity and Bijan, which is not infinity.
Bo Girds sat 2nd of 12 and still sent Patrick Mahomes and Brian Robinson to To Infinity and Bijan for Lamar Jackson.

That is a contender paying extra for the lower-ranked quarterback, 19th by season points against Mahomes at 16th, with a snap share that was down and an Out listing in week 5 on the injury report before the trade.
The upside bet on Jackson is the kind a team near the top can afford, which is the most generous thing to say about Bo Girds parking its 4 RB depth behind 2 quarterbacks.
To Infinity and Bijan, 4-6 and 10th, got the higher-scoring quarterback at 21.4 points per game plus a running back, which is the correct move for a team that far from the top.
This week Mahomes scored 11.48 for To Infinity and Bijan while Jackson sat on the Bo Girds bench, and the trade decided the Bo Girds matchup.
Unsolicited Dak Picks was 4-6 before the trade and responded by shipping out Garrett Wilson, position rank 7 by season points.
Back came Devaughn Vele at 9.9 points per game and Josh Jacobs with no scored game before the trade, which is a bold way to spend a receiver whose target share was going up.
Throw in Bhayshul Tuten, whose snap share was rising to 64 percent, and Unsolicited Dak Picks earns a D for selling the better production at both spots.
Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team gets an A for landing Wilson's 34 percent target share and Tuten's 11.8 points per game without giving up anything that had scored more.
This week Tuten scored 22.7 for Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team, while Jacobs scored 0 on the Unsolicited Dak Picks bench.
To Infinity and Bijan sat 10th of 12 before the trade and responded by trading away the Bijan, rank 2 of 187 by season points.
Back came Jared Goff at 22.8 points per game, plus Malik Nabers with a target share of 33 percent and rising, which is real volume for a team near the bottom.
Return of T Mac, 9th of 12, handed over Goff, Nabers, Braelon Allen and Breece Hall for Bijan Robinson at 22 points per game, so Goff alone was outscoring the prize.
Marvin Harrison rode along at 4.3 points per game, a sweetener in the sense that it was technically included.
This week Bijan Robinson scored 6.3 for To Infinity and Bijan, which is at least on brand.
To Infinity and Bijan scored 46.08, a season low, and finished 60.75 below the median.
At 11th, the infinity part of the name is going about as well as the Bijan part.
Bo Girds cleared the median by 2.79, and Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team missed it by the identical amount, dogging nobody but itself.
Unsolicited Dak Picks also posted a season low at 81.47, a contribution nobody asked for.
The Must Watch sends Return of T Mac and its 3 straight wins into Lil Fridge, the toughest next opponent win rate in the league at 0.83.
Below the cut, Pukancun on 3 at 1-11 meets To Infinity and Bijan at 4-8, a showdown of the awful that someone is required to win.
